title: urn:qauth:ia:new_password:v1-rc.0
description: Sets a password through the one password policy (ADR-017 Decision 8): at registration, at the end of a reset, or when an admin or a breach-list match requires a new one (ADR-020 §3). The reasons of a refusal are returned, never prose. The page marks the field for password managers, with the identifier from the personal data as the username. Works without JavaScript.

purpose.description: Why a new password is asked for, so one screen can say so: a new account, a reset, or a required update.

min_length.description: The shortest password the policy accepts, in code points.

max_length.description: The longest password the policy accepts.

reasons.description: After a refused answer: why the policy refused it.

examples.new_password: a much longer passphrase than before

personal.description: Who the transaction is for, so the screen can show it with a way to switch accounts. Absent until the transaction has an identifier.

identifier.description: The identifier of the account this transaction is for, as the person gave it or as the account holds it. Personal data: only the personal-data read returns it.

error.description: Why the last answer was refused. A closed set.

amr.description: The RFC 8176 `amr` values a successful answer adds to the transaction: none, because the step proves no authenticator.
